ns2:section.sectionText: This course will assist students building a foundation in personal finance and financial planning technologies. Students will begin with budgeting and cash flow calculators, advancing through financial planning, investment and asset mapping software. The class will also focus on Bitcoin, blockchain, roboadvisers and how AI influences the world around us. Prereq ACE240: Any major/discipline can register. Students are required to login and use Moodle/Learn (learn.illinois.edu ) in order to complete this course.
